posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Shared a dreamy May photo dump with a glimpse of baby Vihaan, while Vicky Kaushal celebrated his 38th birthday with sweet family pics.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Announced a historic Wembley Stadium show on Sep 12 — first South Asian artist to headline the venue. Also starring in Imtiaz Ali's 'Main Vaapas Aunga'.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: YRF's 'Alpha' with Sharvari preponed to July 3 release. Meanwhile, continues shooting Sanjay Leela Bhansali's 'Love & War' with Ranbir and Vicky.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Currently filming SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu in Hyderabad. Shared poolside Sunday vibes on Instagram.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: 'King' nearing shoot completion for a Christmas 2026 release with Suhana Khan. Buzz about a romantic drama as his next. Karan Johar unfollowed him on Instagram, sparking speculation.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Wrapped filming Meghna Gulzar's 'Daayra'. Safari vacation photos trending online. Reportedly in talks for a Raj & DK film with Salman Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Injured during 'Eetha' shoot — sustained a fracture. Dating Rahul Mody confirmed. Rumors swirl about a Kalpana Chawla biopic role.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Expecting her second child! Using a body double for action scenes in Allu Arjun's 'Raka'. Also filmed intense sequences for SRK's 'King'.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: 'Dhurandhar' duology crossed ₹3,000 crore worldwide. 'Don 3' hit with FWICE non-cooperation directive controversy. Turned down an offer from Farhan and Zoya Akhtar.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Body-shamed for her 2026 Cannes Film Festival look — Madhuri Dixit came to her defense. Continues her iconic Cannes legacy as a global brand ambassador.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: 'Cocktail 2' trailer launched alongside Kriti Sanon. Married Vijay Deverakonda in a fairy-tale ceremony that had the internet swooning.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Married director Raj Nidimoru! 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' teaser is out. Also joined cricketer Rishabh Pant as a Good Game brand ambassador.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Mega film 'AA22' announced with director Atlee at a record ₹175 crore pay. Deepika Padukone confirmed as co-star in upcoming 'Raka'.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: 'Peddi' releasing June 4 — calls it his most difficult role ever. ₹350 crore budget with AR Rahman's music. Strong US advance booking sales.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel officially announced — first glimpse released to massive hype. Overseas deal locked. Release set for June 11, 2027.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Co-starring with Ram Charan in 'Peddi'. Opened up about her hesitation with Malayalam cinema and joked about Ram Charan's tireless energy on set.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Praised for her horror film 'Obsession' alongside Kartik Aaryan. Promoting the film heavily on Instagram with behind-the-scenes glimpses.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Welcomed a baby girl with Sidharth Malhotra! Opened up about post-pregnancy body shaming in a powerful interview.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Announced his directorial debut — venturing into production. Celebrated son Hrehaan's 20th birthday with ex-wife Sussanne Khan.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Promoting 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' releasing June 5. Signed as Lux Cozi brand ambassador through 2030. Facing a lawsuit from Vashu Bhagnani.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Dropped a live album from her All Hearts Tour. Purchased a luxurious Worli home for ₹29.7 crore. Recalled the time she refused to sing 'Fevicol Se'.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Composed the music for Ram Charan's 'Peddi'. Co-producing 'Masoom' with Shekhar Kapur. Celebrated his 59th birthday with fans worldwide.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Won 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections as TVK party leader — now Chief Minister! His final film 'Jana Nayagan' is stuck at CBFC but expected to release soon.
